newsitem.title: USA: Meditrust gets increased credit facility.
newsitem.headline: Meditrust gets increased credit facility.

text.p: Meditrust on Wednesday said it received a $75 million increase in its unsecured revolving credit facility to $230 million with a consortium of eight banks, including Fleet National Bank as agent and First Union National Bank of North Carolina and Morgan Guaranty Trust Company of New York as co-agents.
The three year unsecured facility provides for interest at prime or LIBOR plus 87.5 basis points, a statement from Meditrust said.

This facility, together with Meditrust's existing $50 million revolving credit facility with Via Banque, brings the company's total available revolving credit facilities to $280 million, the statement said.
